description: This file defines the ClipboardV11 class, which implements clipboard management functionalities for Android API level 11 and above. It handles clipboard entries, listens for clipboard changes, and manages a local cache of clipboard texts.

classes.name: ClipboardV11
classes.description: Implements clipboard operations for Android API level 11+, managing clipboard entries, change listeners, and synchronization with system clipboard.

methods.name: ClipboardV11
methods.description: Constructor initializing the clipboard manager and context.

methods.name: setClipboardUpdatedListener
methods.description: Sets a listener for clipboard updates and manages registration of system clipboard change callbacks.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves a clipboard entry by index.

methods.name: isOsClipboardEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the system clipboard is empty.

methods.name: getClipboardEntriesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of cached clipboard entries.

methods.name: deleteEntry
methods.description: Removes a specific clipboard entry by index.

methods.name: deleteAllEntries
methods.description: Clears all cached entries and the system clipboard.

methods.name: getTextFromClipItem
methods.description: Extracts text from a clipboard item.

methods.name: onPrimaryClipChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when the system clipboard changes; updates internal cache and notifies listener.

methods.name: alreadyKnownText
methods.description: Checks if a text is already the most recent entry.
